items.example: The prime minister said support for Ukraine would remain steadfast despite the alleged intimidation.
items.analysis_zh: remain steadfast 是系动词加形容词，强调在外部压力下仍坚持原有立场；despite 后面接名词短语。与 stubborn 相比，steadfast 常带有坚守承诺的积极语义。
items.cloze: The prime minister said support for Ukraine would remain ______ despite the alleged intimidation.
items.why_zh: remain steadfast 是系动词加形容词，强调在外部压力下仍坚持原有立场；despite 后面接名词短语。

items.example: Shares in New World Development plunged after it announced a large rights issue.
items.analysis_zh: shares plunged 是财经新闻中的不及物动词用法，表示价格短时间大幅下跌。报道所述跌幅接近一半，plunged 比 edged down 或 slipped 更符合量级。after 引出公告与市场反应的先后关系。
items.cloze: Shares in New World Development ______ after it announced a large rights issue.
items.why_zh: shares plunged 是财经新闻中的不及物动词用法，表示价格短时间大幅下跌。

items.example: The proposed shares would be offered at a steep discount to the previous closing price.
items.analysis_zh: at a discount to the closing price 是股票发行定价的常见结构，to 引出比较基准。与 rebate 不同，discount 表示发行价低于参考市价，未必涉及事后返还。would be offered 说明这是拟议发行安排。
items.cloze: The proposed shares would be offered at a steep ______ to the previous closing price.
items.why_zh: at a discount to the closing price 是股票发行定价的常见结构，to 引出比较基准。

items.example: The announcement fuelled concerns about the indebted developer's financial position.
items.analysis_zh: fuel concerns about 是新闻英语中表示助长担忧的动宾搭配，concerns about 后接具体风险对象。与 cause concerns 相比，fuel 通常暗示担忧此前已经存在、如今进一步升温。
items.cloze: The announcement ______ concerns about the indebted developer's financial position.
items.why_zh: fuel concerns about 是新闻英语中表示助长担忧的动宾搭配，concerns about 后接具体风险对象。

items.example: Anthropic is expected to float shares in an initial public offering this week.
items.analysis_zh: float shares 是英式财经英语，表示向公众发行股份并上市；is expected to 表明仍属预期。与 trade shares 不同，float 聚焦首次发行，不能据此认为股票已经开始交易。
items.cloze: Anthropic is expected to ______ shares in an initial public offering this week.
items.why_zh: float shares 是英式财经英语，表示向公众发行股份并上市；is expected to 表明仍属预期。

imitation.background_zh: 投资研究练习：讨论一家拟上市公司的融资计划。
imitation.sentence_en: The company plans to float a minority stake next year.

context.zh: 通过首次公开募股发行股票上市

items.example: The AI company is targeting a valuation of roughly $1.5 trillion.
items.analysis_zh: target a valuation of 加金额是投融资中的目标估值表达；is targeting 表示发行方目前的计划。与 achieve a valuation 相比，targeting 不意味着投资者已经接受这个价格。
items.cloze: The AI company is ______ a valuation of roughly $1.5 trillion.
items.why_zh: target a valuation of 加金额是投融资中的目标估值表达；is targeting 表示发行方目前的计划。

imitation.background_zh: 海外项目练习：在评审会上介绍盈利目标。

context.zh: 目标估值约为1.5万亿美元

items.example: Investors will scrutinise its growth prospects as competition in AI coding tools intensifies.
items.analysis_zh: scrutinise growth prospects 是正式财经动宾搭配，强调对收入增长假设和商业模式作严格检视。as 引出竞争加剧的背景；与 glance at 相比，scrutinise 表示细致且带批判性的分析。
items.cloze: Investors will ______ its growth prospects as competition in AI coding tools intensifies.
items.why_zh: scrutinise growth prospects 是正式财经动宾搭配，强调对收入增长假设和商业模式作严格检视。

imitation.background_zh: 产能评估：承诺交期前审核供应商的测算依据。
imitation.sentence_en: We need to scrutinise the supplier's capacity assumptions before confirming the delivery schedule.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们需要仔细审查供应商的产能假设，再确认交付计划。

context.zh: 仔细评估其增长前景

items.example: The Nasdaq index retreated by 2.7% as investors questioned whether the artificial-intelligence boom could sustain its pace.
items.analysis_zh: retreated by 2.7% 表示指数回落了2.7%，财经报道常用 retreat 指股价或指数退回较低水平。retreat by 后面接变化幅度；retreat to 后面通常接具体点位。句中 as investors questioned 交代市场担忧的背景，不能据此断言只有这一项原因推动跌势。plummet 表达更剧烈的暴跌，语气较强。
items.cloze: The Nasdaq index ______ by 2.7% as investors questioned whether the artificial-intelligence boom could sustain its pace.
items.hint_zh: 描述股指的百分比回落。
items.why_zh: 指数后接 by + 百分比幅度，retreated 能自然表达回落，不夸大走势。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，个人投资：复盘科技板块调整并记录跌幅。
imitation.sentence_en: The technology index retreated by 3% after a weak earnings report.
imitation.translation_zh: 疲弱的财报发布后，科技指数回落了3%。

context.en: retreated by 2.7%
context.zh: 回落了2.7%

items.example: Shares in Nvidia sank more than 4% as markets absorbed the departure of its founder from the top job.
items.analysis_zh: shares in Nvidia sank more than 4% 中，sink 的过去式 sank 是股市报道描述大幅下跌的生动动词，后面可直接接 more than + 百分数。它比 slipped 更强调跌势，比 crashed 通常温和。as markets absorbed 说明投资者正在消化管理层消息，不能将变动机械归因于单一事件。
items.cloze: Shares in Nvidia ______ more than 4% as markets absorbed the departure of its founder from the top job.
items.why_zh: shares 为复数主语，sank 是正确过去式，并可直接跟跌幅 more than 4%。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，篮球：核心球员临时缺阵后门票转售价下跌。
imitation.sentence_en: Resale ticket prices sank after the team's star player was ruled out.
imitation.translation_zh: 球队明星球员确定缺阵后，转售门票价格大幅下跌。

context.en: sank more than 4%
context.zh: 跌幅超过4%

items.example: The sell-off also unsettled chipmakers in Asia, suggesting that anxiety had spread beyond American markets.
items.analysis_zh: the sell-off unsettled chipmakers 是及物动词搭配，表示抛售扰动了亚洲芯片企业的预期或市场信心。rattle 更突出突发冲击，disrupt 可能让人误以为工厂生产实际中断。suggesting that 引出媒体依据跨市场表现作出的审慎判断，不能据此认定所有亚洲企业受影响程度相同。
items.cloze: The sell-off also ______ chipmakers in Asia, suggesting that anxiety had spread beyond American markets.
items.hint_zh: 抛售波及亚洲芯片行业。
items.why_zh: 后接 chipmakers 作宾语，unsettled 表达市场信心受扰，同时避免暗示生产停摆。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，供应链：原料交期突然变化引起项目组担忧。
imitation.sentence_en: The unexpected lead-time change unsettled the project team.
imitation.translation_zh: 交期的意外变化让项目团队感到不安。

context.en: unsettled chipmakers in Asia
context.zh: 令亚洲芯片厂商感到不安

items.example: After Jensen Huang's resignation, America's Commerce Department issued an interim rule on remote access to advanced AI chips.
items.analysis_zh: issued an interim rule 表示主管部门发布临时性规则，issue 与 guidance、notice、regulation 都是常见正式搭配。interim 强调过渡性质，不能据此说限制永久有效。与 propose 相比，issue 表示已经发布；announce 更侧重向公众宣告，未必等于所有执行细则均已落实。
items.cloze: After Jensen Huang's resignation, America's Commerce Department ______ an interim rule on remote access to advanced AI chips.
items.hint_zh: 政府部门发布临时规则。
items.why_zh: Commerce Department 与 rule 构成政府行为搭配，issued 最准确表达已正式发布的动作。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，工厂：质量部门就受影响批次发布临时操作指引。
imitation.sentence_en: The quality team issued interim guidance for the affected batches.
imitation.translation_zh: 质量团队针对受影响批次发布了临时指引。

context.en: issued an interim rule
context.zh: 发布了一项临时规定

items.example: The measure aims to prevent firms from circumventing American export controls by renting computing capacity overseas.
items.analysis_zh: prevent firms from circumventing export controls 属于 prevent + 宾语 + from + V-ing 结构。circumvent 表示通过迂回方式绕过规则；此处具体指借境外数据中心获取算力的潜在监管漏洞。evade 也有规避限制的含义，avoid 可能只是合法避开风险，语义偏弱。规则旨在预防行为，不能把所有相关企业都认定为违法。
items.cloze: The measure aims to prevent firms from ______ American export controls by renting computing capacity overseas.
items.hint_zh: prevent firms from 后使用动名词。
items.why_zh: 固定搭配 prevent ... from 后面必须使用 -ing，且语义针对绕过出口管制。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，合同管理：明确禁止绕开双方约定的审批流程。
imitation.sentence_en: The contract bars either party from circumventing the approval process.
imitation.translation_zh: 合同禁止任何一方规避审批流程。

context.en: circumventing American export controls
context.zh: 规避美国的出口管制

items.example: Despite calls for Huang's return, Nvidia's board was reportedly not considering reinstating him as chief executive.
items.analysis_zh: considering reinstating him as chief executive 中，后一个 -ing 是 consider 后作宾语的动名词。reinstate someone as + 职务表示使某人恢复原有职位；appoint 一般只强调任命，未突出曾任职。reportedly 说明董事会意向来自媒体报道，不能说是公司的正式声明。
items.cloze: Despite calls for Huang's return, Nvidia's board was reportedly not considering ______ him as chief executive.
items.why_zh: consider + V-ing 是固定句法，而 reinstating 适用于已离任高管恢复原职的情形。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，篮球：俱乐部讨论让前任队长重新担任队长。
imitation.sentence_en: The club is considering reinstating its former captain next season.
imitation.translation_zh: 俱乐部正在考虑下赛季恢复前队长的队长职务。

context.en: reinstating him as chief executive
context.zh: 让他重新担任首席执行官

items.example: JPMorgan Chase said a software bug had disrupted some customer transactions.
items.analysis_zh: a software bug 指软件代码中的错误，bug 是可数名词，与冠词 a 搭配。报道限定 some customer transactions，不能推断银行全部业务停止。glitch 常指暂时性异常，bug 更偏向程序缺陷；cyberattack 表示网络攻击，银行没有将此次中断认定为攻击事件。
items.cloze: JPMorgan Chase said a software ______ had disrupted some customer transactions.
items.hint_zh: software 后的可数单数名词。
items.why_zh: a software 后需要可数单数名词，bug 符合银行描述的软件故障原因。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，英语学习网站：部分笔记未成功保存，需要排查程序。
imitation.sentence_en: A software bug prevented some study notes from saving.
imitation.translation_zh: 一个软件缺陷导致部分学习笔记未能保存。

context.en: a software bug
context.zh: 一个软件缺陷

items.example: The bank said it had found no evidence that the disruption was related to a cyberattack.
items.analysis_zh: found no evidence that ... 是新闻中常见的否定证据结构，evidence 在此通常不可数，不能写 an evidence。银行表示核查尚无相关证据，不等于最终排除所有安全事件。proof 通常强调更高证明程度，indication 强调迹象；had found 用过去完成时衔接声明前的调查。
items.cloze: The bank said it had found no ______ that the disruption was related to a cyberattack.
items.hint_zh: 未发现网络攻击证据的审慎表述。
items.why_zh: found no evidence that 准确保留银行声明中的不确定性，避免把未发现证据说成定论。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，质量调查：核查运输是否造成包装漏液。
imitation.sentence_en: The review found no evidence that transport damage caused the leakage.
imitation.translation_zh: 调查未发现证据表明运输损伤造成了漏液。

context.en: no evidence that the disruption was related to a cyberattack
context.zh: 没有证据表明此次中断与网络攻击有关

items.example: United Airlines separately said it had resolved a widespread system outage affecting its operations.
items.analysis_zh: a widespread system outage 表示覆盖面较广的系统中断，widespread 是形容词，置于 system outage 前。widespread 描述影响范围；severe 更多描述严重程度，两者侧重点不同。had resolved 是航空公司对修复状态的表述，不能据此推断每架航班已立刻正常运行。
items.cloze: United Airlines separately said it had resolved a ______ system outage affecting its operations.
items.hint_zh: 修饰 system outage 的范围形容词。
items.why_zh: 该空修饰 outage，widespread 能体现系统故障影响广泛的范围。

imitation.sentence_en: A widespread signalling outage delayed trains across the city.

context.zh: 一次大范围的系统中断

items.example: Five EU governments agreed on a plan to establish a deportation centre in Rwanda next year.
items.analysis_zh: agreed on a plan 表示参与各方就计划取得一致，agree on 后面常接共同讨论的议题或方案，agree to 则更常接具体条款或行动。next year 指计划执行时间，达成共识并不意味着中心已经建成。settled on 侧重权衡后作出选择，agreed on 更突出多方共识。
items.cloze: Five EU governments ______ on a plan to establish a deportation centre in Rwanda next year.
items.hint_zh: 与 on a plan 搭配。
items.why_zh: 五国作为复数主语，与 on a plan 自然构成 agreed on 的搭配。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，海外本地化：三个区域团队一致确认试生产计划。
imitation.sentence_en: The three regional teams agreed on a revised trial-production schedule.
imitation.translation_zh: 三个区域团队就修订后的试生产计划达成一致。

context.zh: 就一项计划达成一致

items.example: The proposal concerns migrants who have exhausted their legal options to remain in the EU.
items.analysis_zh: have exhausted their legal options 是现在完成时，强调截至相关时点法律途径已经用尽。exhaust + options / remedies / appeals 是法律政策写作中的常见搭配，不能加 of。仅用 used 而不加 up，难以准确表达完全耗尽。它是拟议政策的适用条件，不代表每个潜在对象的实际情况都已确认。
items.cloze: The proposal concerns migrants who have ______ their legal options to remain in the EU.
items.hint_zh: 已经用尽合法居留途径。
items.why_zh: have 后需过去分词，exhausted legal options 能准确表示用尽合法途径。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，合同争议：内部协商渠道全部尝试后申请调解。
imitation.sentence_en: The team exhausted its internal options before requesting formal mediation.
imitation.translation_zh: 团队在申请正式调解前用尽了内部解决途径。

context.en: exhausted their legal options to remain in the EU
context.zh: 已用尽合法留在欧盟的所有途径

items.example: Legal challenges to the scheme are expected even if the governments proceed.
items.analysis_zh: legal challenges to the scheme 指针对该政策提出的司法挑战，challenge to + 政策或决定是常见介词搭配。challenges 用复数表示可能有不止一项法律争议。are expected 表示预计会发生，不能把尚未出现的诉讼写成已经立案；objections 也可指法律异议，但范围未必完全相同。
items.cloze: Legal ______ to the scheme are expected even if the governments proceed.
items.hint_zh: 对拟议政策提出诉讼或法律质疑。
items.why_zh: Legal 后需复数可数名词，challenges to 准确表达可能针对该方案提出的法律质疑。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，合同管理：新条款可能面临外部法律质疑。
imitation.sentence_en: The proposed contract clause could face legal challenges.

items.example: Russian missile strikes forced the closure of two bridges across Kyiv's Dnieper river.
items.analysis_zh: forced the closure of two bridges 是 force + 名词性结果 的表达，强调外力使关闭成为必要。prompted 更偏触发决定，triggered 更偏引发事件，force 体现实际压力。句中说的是两座桥被迫关闭，不能延伸为全城交通瘫痪。与 force somebody to do something 相比，这里直接接名词 closure。
items.cloze: Russian missile strikes ______ the closure of two bridges across Kyiv's Dnieper river.
items.hint_zh: 袭击令桥梁不得不关闭。
items.why_zh: strikes 后接名词 the closure，forced 能表达打击迫使桥梁关闭的强因果关系。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，供应链：港口关闭使原定发货延期。
imitation.sentence_en: The port closure forced a delay in the planned shipment.
imitation.translation_zh: 港口关闭迫使原定发货计划延期。

context.zh: 迫使两座桥梁关闭

items.example: The bridge connecting Russia with Crimea remains a crucial supply route for Russian troops.
items.analysis_zh: a crucial supply route for Russian troops 中，crucial 修饰 supply route，for 引出使用该补给通道的部队。critical 与 vital 接近，important 程度稍弱。remains 表示这一战略重要性仍然存在，但没有断言所有军需物资必须经由该桥。财经或项目管理中也常见 crucial to the success of。
items.cloze: The bridge connecting Russia with Crimea remains a ______ supply route for Russian troops.
items.hint_zh: 修饰 supply route 的重要性形容词。
items.why_zh: 空格需要重要程度形容词，crucial 与军事补给线的战略价值相符。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，海外工厂：区域港口是物料运输的关键通道。
imitation.sentence_en: The regional port remains a crucial supply route for the new factory.
imitation.translation_zh: 该区域港口仍是新工厂至关重要的补给通道。

context.en: a crucial supply route
context.zh: 一条关键补给线

items.example: The strikes illustrated how transport links can become strategic targets during a prolonged war.
items.analysis_zh: illustrated how + 从句利用具体事件解释更一般的机制，illustrate 也可直接接名词，如 illustrate the importance of。proved 意味着已严格证明，新闻写作中过于绝对；illustrated 只表达事件具有说明作用。prolonged war 指持续时间较长的战争，不含对结束日期的预测。
items.cloze: The strikes ______ how transport links can become strategic targets during a prolonged war.
items.hint_zh: 具体事件用于说明普遍机制。
items.why_zh: strikes 与 how 从句之间需要过去式动词，illustrated 语气审慎且搭配自然。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，摄影旅行：山路封闭说明行程预案的重要性。
imitation.sentence_en: The road closure illustrated how fragile a tightly planned itinerary can be.
imitation.translation_zh: 道路封闭说明过于紧凑的行程可能多么脆弱。

context.en: illustrated how transport links can become strategic targets
context.zh: 说明了交通要道如何成为战略目标

items.example: Critics alleged that a rushed review of India's voter rolls had removed eligible citizens.
items.analysis_zh: Critics alleged that ... 是带明确来源的新闻归因，表示批评者提出了有待核实的指控。allege 后直接接 that 从句；confirm 表示得到确认，不能替代。a rushed review 反映批评者认为程序仓促，并未说明法院已经认定相关删名行为违法。had removed 是相对于批评者声明的更早动作。
items.cloze: Critics ______ that a rushed review of India's voter rolls had removed eligible citizens.
items.hint_zh: 有争议的说法须明确归于批评者。
items.why_zh: 争议尚在司法审查中，alleged 能准确保留批评者的主张属性。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，采购合规：供应商指称招标程序存在不公。
imitation.sentence_en: The supplier alleged that the bidding process had been unfair.
imitation.translation_zh: 该供应商指称招标程序存在不公平情况。

context.en: alleged that a rushed review of India's voter rolls had removed eligible citizens
context.zh: 指称印度仓促审查选民名册，导致合格选民遭到除名

items.example: Petitioners want access to commission records to establish how removal decisions were made.
items.analysis_zh: establish how decisions were made 意为根据档案或证据查明决定形成的方式，establish 后可直接接 how 从句，无需 about。assume 表示猜测，establish 更强调证据支持；determine 强调查明，verify 更侧重核实已有说法。want access 表示申请查阅，不能说他们已经取得全部资料。
items.cloze: Petitioners want access to commission records to ______ how removal decisions were made.
items.hint_zh: 通过档案厘清具体决策过程。
items.why_zh: to 后须动词原形，establish how 自然表达使用记录核查决策过程。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，生产计划：审查 ERP 记录查明交期变更流程。
imitation.sentence_en: We reviewed the records to establish how the delivery date was changed.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们审查记录，以查明交货日期是如何被修改的。

context.en: establish how removal decisions were made
context.zh: 查明除名决定是如何作出的

items.example: The dispute could undermine public confidence in the body responsible for election oversight.
items.analysis_zh: could undermine public confidence in ... 表示争议可能侵蚀公众对机构的信心，could 后必须用动词原形，confidence in 后面接信任对象。undermine 指削弱信任基础，destroy 往往过于绝对。句中只谈潜在影响，不能据此判断机构信誉已经全面崩溃；也可用于 undermine investor confidence。
items.cloze: The dispute could ______ public confidence in the body responsible for election oversight.
items.hint_zh: could 后接原形，表达潜在信任损害。
items.why_zh: could 后需要动词原形，undermine 与 confidence in 构成自然财经和公共事务搭配。

imitation.background_zh: 假设情境，项目合作：里程碑反复修改可能影响合作方信心。
imitation.sentence_en: Repeated milestone changes could undermine our partner's confidence in the plan.
imitation.translation_zh: 反复修改里程碑可能削弱合作伙伴对计划的信心。

context.en: undermine public confidence
context.zh: 削弱公众的信任

items.example: The Quad's leaders were due to meet on the sidelines of an ASEAN summit in Manila, their first gathering in two years.
items.analysis_zh: on the sidelines of an ASEAN summit 指利用东盟峰会举行期间进行其他会晤，通常是正式议程之外的配套外交活动。on the margins of 也成立，但不能写 at the sidelines of。句中 were due to meet 表示预定会晤，仍有时间上的不确定性；their first gathering in two years 限定的是 Quad 领导人会议的间隔。商务场景可说 discuss a proposal on the sidelines of a conference。
items.cloze: The Quad's leaders were due to meet on the ______ of an ASEAN summit in Manila, their first gathering in two years.
items.hint_zh: 常见外交搭配 on the sidelines of a summit
items.why_zh: on the sidelines of 是报道峰会期间双边或小多边会晤的固定表达；margins 也是合适的单词替换。

imitation.background_zh: 假设商务场景，参加行业展会时顺便讨论供应商合作。
imitation.sentence_en: We discussed the supply agreement on the sidelines of the industry conference.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们在行业会议期间利用会外时间讨论了供应协议。

context.en: on the sidelines of an ASEAN summit
context.zh: 在东盟峰会期间的正式议程之外

items.example: The four-country grouping is intended as a strategic counterweight to China's growing influence in the Pacific.
items.analysis_zh: a strategic counterweight to China's growing influence 中，counterweight 本义是平衡重量的配重，外交语境延伸为能够制衡另一方影响力的力量。固定结构是 a counterweight to + 名词，不能直接换成 check，因为通常说 a check on。is intended as 明确这是该机制被赋予的战略目的，并未证明其已达到制衡效果。项目管理中可用 counterweight to excessive centralisation 描述对过度集权的平衡机制。
items.cloze: The four-country grouping is intended as a strategic ______ to China's growing influence in the Pacific.
items.why_zh: counterweight 与介词 to 形成准确的政策分析搭配，强调制衡功能而不暗示结果已实现。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目治理情境，为避免决策权过度集中而设置独立评审。
imitation.sentence_en: An independent review board can act as a counterweight to excessive centralisation.
imitation.translation_zh: 独立评审委员会可以对过度集中的决策权形成制衡。

context.en: a strategic counterweight to China's growing influence
context.zh: 用来制衡中国日益增长的影响力的一股战略力量

items.example: The White House said later talks with the leaders of China and Russia would address nuclear weapons.
items.analysis_zh: would address nuclear weapons 中，address 作及物动词表示在正式会谈中讨论或处理某个议题，可直接接 issue、concern、risk 或 nuclear weapons，无需额外介词。discuss 更偏交换意见，address 往往暗示把议题列入处理范围；solve 则暗示问题已解决，语义过强。The White House said 将谈判议题归于白宫声明，would 表示当时计划中的未来安排，不能写成会谈已经完成。
items.cloze: The White House said later talks with the leaders of China and Russia would ______ nuclear weapons.
items.hint_zh: address nuclear weapons as a topic of talks
items.why_zh: address 可直接接 nuclear weapons，表达正式外交议程将涉及这一议题，同时保留计划性质。

imitation.background_zh: 假设跨部门项目会议，需要集中处理海外工厂的交期风险。
imitation.sentence_en: The steering committee will address delivery risks at its next meeting.
imitation.translation_zh: 项目指导委员会将在下次会议上讨论交付风险。

context.en: address nuclear weapons
context.zh: 讨论核武器问题

items.example: Robert Pattinson was named as the next James Bond, adding another famous character to his screen career.
items.analysis_zh: was named as the next James Bond 中，name 是及物动词的被动形式，表示正式公布某人担任某个角色或职位；be named as + 身份 是新闻标题中的常见结构。cast as 更强调选角，chosen as 强调选择过程，announced as 强调公开宣布，均可填入原句。adding another famous character 是现在分词短语，补充说明这一角色对演员履历的意义，不意味着影片已经上映。
items.cloze: Robert Pattinson was ______ as the next James Bond, adding another famous character to his screen career.
items.why_zh: 被动结构 was named as 能准确表达演员人选已公布，并与后面的角色名称自然搭配。

imitation.background_zh: 假设篮球新闻，一名球员获选为球队新任队长。
imitation.sentence_en: The veteran guard was named as the team's new captain.
imitation.translation_zh: 这名经验丰富的后卫被任命为球队新队长。

context.en: named as the next James Bond
context.zh: 被选定为下一任詹姆斯·邦德的扮演者

items.example: Denis Villeneuve is set to helm the 26th instalment of the film series.
items.analysis_zh: helm the 26th instalment 中，helm 作动词表示执导电影或领导项目，源自船舵的意象。direct 是影视制作中更直接的同义词；manage 通常指日常管理，不一定意味着担任导演。is set to + 动词原形表示已安排或预计将发生，不能据此断言电影已经拍完。instalment 在英式英语中可指系列电影的一部，美式拼写 installment 也常见。商务表达可以用 helm a transformation programme。
items.cloze: Denis Villeneuve is set to ______ the 26th instalment of the film series.
items.hint_zh: helm a film or a major project
items.why_zh: to 后需要动词原形，helm 能准确指导演掌舵一部系列电影，与 direct 可互换。

imitation.background_zh: 假设工作场景，一位项目经理负责领导跨国系统切换。
imitation.sentence_en: An experienced project manager will helm the regional system migration.
imitation.translation_zh: 一位经验丰富的项目经理将主导区域系统迁移。

context.en: helm the 26th instalment of the film series
context.zh: 执导该系列的第26部电影

items.example: By the time of the announcement, the previous 25 Bond films had grossed an inflation-adjusted $23bn.
items.analysis_zh: the previous 25 Bond films had grossed an inflation-adjusted $23bn 中，gross 是电影票房报道的专门动词，强调总收入，不能直接理解为扣除成本后的利润。had grossed 为过去完成时，表示截至该次宣布之前的累计结果。earned 和 generated 可表达产生收入，但 grossed 在票房语境更精确。inflation-adjusted 表示已进行通胀调整，金额不能与未经调整的名义票房直接比较。
items.cloze: By the time of the announcement, the previous 25 Bond films had ______ an inflation-adjusted $23bn.
items.hint_zh: gross an amount at the box office
items.why_zh: 电影作主语且后接累计票房金额，grossed 是最精确的行业用词，过去分词形式与 had 配合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设财经新闻，一部纪录片上映后公布全球票房。
imitation.sentence_en: The documentary grossed $12m worldwide during its first month.
imitation.translation_zh: 这部纪录片上映首月在全球取得了1200万美元票房。

context.en: grossed an inflation-adjusted $23bn
context.zh: 取得按通胀调整后达230亿美元的总票房

items.meaning_zh: 为决定辩护，维护其合理性
items.example: In a new memoir, former president Joe Biden sought to defend his decisions during his time in office.
items.analysis_zh: sought to defend his decisions 中，seek to + 动词原形表示试图达到某种目的，defend one's decisions 指为过去的决定辩护。justify 更强调证明决定有充分理由，explain 仅需说明背景，vindicate 语气更强，侧重证明过去的判断正确。sought to 仅描述作者的写作意图，不能推出读者已被说服。新闻分析也常说 defend a policy decision against criticism。
items.cloze: In a new memoir, former president Joe Biden sought to ______ his decisions during his time in office.
items.why_zh: sought to 后用动词原形，defend 与 his decisions 构成自然搭配，符合回忆录为执政记录辩护的语境。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合同谈判复盘，项目负责人向管理层说明采购策略。
imitation.sentence_en: The project lead sought to defend the revised sourcing strategy.
imitation.translation_zh: 项目负责人试图为修订后的采购策略进行辩护。

context.en: defend his decisions during his time in office
context.zh: 为自己任内作出的决定辩护

items.example: The Economist's reviewer faulted the book for offering too little reflection on his unsuccessful re-election effort.
items.analysis_zh: faulted the book for offering too little reflection 属于 fault + 宾语 + for + V-ing，指出某个作品或行为的具体不足。criticised 或 criticized 也成立，但 fault 尤其强调可以明确指出的缺点。too little reflection 表示评论者认为反思不足，这是 The Economist 评论者的评价，并非独立核实的客观事实。与 accuse somebody of 相比，fault something for 适用于对作品质量和论证方式的批评。
items.cloze: The Economist's reviewer ______ the book for offering too little reflection on his unsuccessful re-election effort.
items.hint_zh: fault somebody or something for doing something
items.why_zh: faulted ... for offering 与 for 后的动名词构成固定句法，并准确保留评论者的批评立场。

imitation.background_zh: 假设供应链评审，团队指出预测报告缺少风险分析。
imitation.sentence_en: The review panel faulted the forecast for overlooking supplier risks.
imitation.translation_zh: 评审小组批评这份预测报告忽视了供应商风险。

context.en: faulted the book for offering too little reflection
context.zh: 批评这本书反思不够深入

items.example: His promotional tour was curtailed because of illness, according to the review.
items.analysis_zh: His promotional tour was curtailed because of illness 使用被动语态，curtail 表示计划中的活动被迫缩减规模或时长，常搭配 tour、spending、operations、freedom。shorten 更强调时间变短，limit 强调施加限制，curtail 则通常包含原计划受到约束的含义。according to the review 说明消息依据是该篇评论，不能推断全部宣传活动都已取消。财经报道也可说 curtail capital expenditure。
items.cloze: His promotional tour was ______ because of illness, according to the review.
items.hint_zh: curtail a tour, activity or spending
items.why_zh: was 后需要过去分词，curtailed 准确描述原定宣传行程被缩减，同时没有夸大为彻底取消。

imitation.background_zh: 假设旅行安排，恶劣天气导致原定摄影行程缩短。
imitation.sentence_en: Heavy rain curtailed our photography trip along the coast.
imitation.translation_zh: 大雨迫使我们缩短了沿海摄影行程。

context.en: His promotional tour was curtailed because of illness
context.zh: 他因病缩短了巡回宣传行程

items.example: The board chair rejected demands to reinstate Jensen Huang.
items.cloze: The board chair ______ demands to reinstate Jensen Huang.
items.analysis_zh: rejected demands to reinstate 是 reject + 名词 + to do 的结构，表示否定明确的复职要求。报道限定为董事长公开表态，不推断所有股东立场；dismissed 可以描述驳回，但 rejected 更直接对应要求。
items.why_zh: rejected demands to reinstate 是 reject + 名词 + to do 的结构，表示否定明确的复职要求。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合同谈判：客户提出临时降价要求。
imitation.sentence_en: The supplier rejected demands to cut prices immediately.
imitation.translation_zh: 供应商拒绝了立即降价的要求。

context.en: rejected demands to reinstate Jensen Huang
context.zh: 拒绝了让黄仁勋复职的要求

items.example: The announcement coincided with quarterly revenue growth of 103% from a year earlier.
items.cloze: The announcement ______ with quarterly revenue growth of 103% from a year earlier.
items.analysis_zh: coincided with 后接名词短语，指出公告与季度营收同比增长103%的时间重合。coincide 不直接表示因果，不能写成财报导致董事长决定；它是不及物动词，后接 with。
items.why_zh: coincided with 后接名词短语，指出公告与季度营收同比增长103%的时间重合。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目管理：交付日恰逢年度盘点。
imitation.sentence_en: The delivery coincided with the annual inventory count.
imitation.translation_zh: 交付恰逢年度库存盘点。

context.en: coincided with quarterly revenue growth of 103% from a year earlier
context.zh: 恰逢该季度营收同比增长103%

items.example: The company's market value had shrunk by about $250bn since Huang resigned.
items.cloze: The company's market value had ______ by about $250bn since Huang resigned.
items.analysis_zh: had shrunk by 表示到报道时已经累计减少某个金额，过去完成时对应此前辞职以来的变化。shrink by 指减少幅度，shrink to 指剩余规模；市值缩水也不等于公司发生同额经营亏损。
items.why_zh: had shrunk by 表示到报道时已经累计减少某个金额，过去完成时对应此前辞职以来的变化。

imitation.background_zh: 假设投资复盘：观察公司估值变化。
imitation.sentence_en: Its valuation had shrunk by a fifth before the recovery.
imitation.translation_zh: 复苏之前，它的估值已缩水五分之一。

context.en: had shrunk by about $250bn
context.zh: 已缩水约2500亿美元

items.example: Xi Jinping urged countries to defend open trade at the Shenzhen summit.
items.cloze: Xi Jinping ______ countries to defend open trade at the Shenzhen summit.
items.analysis_zh: urged countries to defend 属于 urge + 宾语 + to do，表示领导人敦促其他国家行动。比 suggested 语气更强，但仍是讲话倡议，不证明参会国已达成共同决定。
items.why_zh: urged countries to defend 属于 urge + 宾语 + to do，表示领导人敦促其他国家行动。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目协作：催促伙伴确认计划。
imitation.sentence_en: The manager urged partners to confirm the timetable.
imitation.translation_zh: 经理敦促伙伴确认时间表。

context.en: urged countries to defend open trade
context.zh: 敦促各国维护开放贸易

items.example: Xi portrayed China as a source of stability in the multilateral trading system.
items.cloze: Xi ______ China as a source of stability in the multilateral trading system.
items.analysis_zh: portrayed China as a source of stability 使用 portray A as B，表示讲话者塑造的形象。新闻应归因于演讲内容，不能将自我定位直接视为客观结论；presented 也能自然表达这一展示行为。
items.why_zh: portrayed China as a source of stability 使用 portray A as B，表示讲话者塑造的形象。

imitation.background_zh: 假设英文演讲：描述试点项目。
imitation.sentence_en: The speaker portrayed the pilot as a model for expansion.
imitation.translation_zh: 演讲者将试点项目描绘为扩张范例。

context.en: portrayed China as a source of stability
context.zh: 将中国描述为稳定力量

items.example: Putin criticised sanctions on Russia and attacked Western powers in his speech.
items.cloze: Putin ______ sanctions on Russia and attacked Western powers in his speech.
items.analysis_zh: criticised sanctions on Russia 中 criticise 是及物动词，直接接批评对象，on Russia 修饰 sanctions。英式 criticised 与美式 criticized 均正确；句子只记录发言，不为其政治判断背书。
items.why_zh: criticised sanctions on Russia 中 criticise 是及物动词，直接接批评对象，on Russia 修饰 sanctions。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合同评审：法务批评出口限制。
imitation.sentence_en: The legal team criticised the proposed export restrictions.
imitation.translation_zh: 法务团队批评了拟议的出口限制。

context.en: criticised sanctions on Russia
context.zh: 批评针对俄罗斯的制裁

items.example: Xi greeted Donald Trump at Shenzhen airport before planned talks.
items.cloze: Xi ______ Donald Trump at Shenzhen airport before planned talks.
items.analysis_zh: greeted somebody at the airport 是迎接来访者的常见搭配。报道明确的是机场礼宾动作，不能直接推断外交关系改善；welcomed 同样符合接待语境，但情感色彩略强。
items.why_zh: greeted somebody at the airport 是迎接来访者的常见搭配。

imitation.background_zh: 假设商务接待：迎接海外工程师。
imitation.sentence_en: The host greeted visiting engineers at the factory.
imitation.translation_zh: 接待人员在工厂迎接来访工程师。

context.en: greeted Donald Trump at Shenzhen airport
context.zh: 在深圳机场迎接唐纳德·特朗普

items.example: The airport reception signalled a departure from Xi's usual diplomatic protocol.
items.cloze: The airport reception ______ a departure from Xi's usual diplomatic protocol.
items.analysis_zh: signalled a departure from 表示某个行为体现了偏离惯例的信号；departure from 在这里指做法变化。signalled 不等于证实政策改变，美式 signaled 也成立。
items.why_zh: signalled a departure from 表示某个行为体现了偏离惯例的信号；departure from 在这里指做法变化。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目会议：高层参与改变惯例。
imitation.sentence_en: The director's presence signalled a departure from normal practice.
imitation.translation_zh: 总监出席显示做法有别于惯例。

context.en: signalled a departure from Xi's usual diplomatic protocol
context.zh: 表明这次安排有别于习近平惯常的外交礼宾做法

items.example: Trump had previously pledged to deepen defence co-operation with the Philippines.
items.cloze: Trump had previously ______ to deepen defence co-operation with the Philippines.
items.analysis_zh: had pledged to deepen 是过去完成时加 pledge to do，标记抵华前作出的正式承诺。承诺属于政策表态，不能据此认定合作已经深化；promised 语气稍普通，vowed 更强调决心。
items.why_zh: had pledged to deepen 是过去完成时加 pledge to do，标记抵华前作出的正式承诺。

imitation.background_zh: 假设英语学习：课程开始前承诺练习。
imitation.sentence_en: She had pledged to practise speaking daily.
imitation.translation_zh: 她此前承诺每天练习口语。

context.en: pledged to deepen defence co-operation
context.zh: 承诺深化防务合作

items.example: Annual consumer-price inflation accelerated to 3.6% in October from 3.5% in September.
items.cloze: Annual consumer-price inflation ______ to 3.6% in October from 3.5% in September.
items.analysis_zh: accelerated to 3.6% from 3.5% 说明通胀率从旧水平升至新水平，to 与 from 分别标记终点和起点。通胀加速表示价格上涨速度变快，不能理解为物价下降；rose 也符合数字变化。
items.why_zh: accelerated to 3.6% from 3.5% 说明通胀率从旧水平升至新水平，to 与 from 分别标记终点和起点。

imitation.background_zh: 假设宏观研究：能源成本推动通胀。
imitation.sentence_en: Inflation accelerated to 4% after fuel costs rose.
imitation.translation_zh: 燃料成本上涨后，通胀率升至4%。

context.en: inflation accelerated to 3.6%
context.zh: 通胀率升至3.6%

items.example: The increase was largely attributed to higher energy costs linked to the Iran war.
items.cloze: The increase was largely ______ to higher energy costs linked to the Iran war.
items.analysis_zh: was largely attributed to 是被动语态，表示主要归因于某个因素；largely 保留其他因素可能存在的空间。attribute to 是中性归因结构，blame on 则更强调责任归咎。
items.why_zh: was largely attributed to 是被动语态，表示主要归因于某个因素；largely 保留其他因素可能存在的空间。

imitation.background_zh: 假设供应链分析：解释成本增长。
imitation.sentence_en: The increase was largely attributed to freight charges.
imitation.translation_zh: 上涨主要归因于运费。

context.en: attributed to higher energy costs
context.zh: 归因于能源成本上涨

items.example: The figures could prompt the Bank of England to raise rates again.
items.cloze: The figures could ______ the Bank of England to raise rates again.
items.analysis_zh: could prompt somebody to do 表示可能促使机构采取行动，could 明确保留不确定性。prompt 强调数据可能触发决策，不能用强制性更高的 force 来断言央行没有选择。
items.why_zh: could prompt somebody to do 表示可能促使机构采取行动，could 明确保留不确定性。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目风险：延误可能引发计划调整。
imitation.sentence_en: Repeated delays could prompt the team to revise its plan.
imitation.translation_zh: 反复延误可能促使团队修改计划。

context.en: prompt the Bank of England to raise rates again
context.zh: 促使英国央行再次加息

items.example: Ukraine targeted the bridge between Russia and Crimea with missiles and drones.
items.cloze: Ukraine ______ the bridge between Russia and Crimea with missiles and drones.
items.analysis_zh: targeted the bridge with missiles and drones 采用 target + 目标 + with + 手段，明确攻击对象与工具。target 为及物动词，无需 target at；句子没有推断更广泛的军事目的。
items.why_zh: targeted the bridge with missiles and drones 采用 target + 目标 + with + 手段，明确攻击对象与工具。

imitation.background_zh: 假设网络演练：模拟攻击关键服务器。
imitation.sentence_en: The exercise targeted a server with repeated requests.
imitation.translation_zh: 演练通过反复请求攻击一台服务器。

context.en: targeted the bridge between Russia and Crimea
context.zh: 将连接俄罗斯与克里米亚的大桥列为打击目标

items.example: The damage disrupted an important supply route for Russian forces.
items.cloze: The damage ______ an important supply route for Russian forces.
items.analysis_zh: disrupted an important supply route 表示运输路线运作受影响。disrupt 比 destroy 克制，桥梁部分坍塌不能自动等同于整个供应网络永久消失；interrupted 可表示运输中断。
items.why_zh: disrupted an important supply route 表示运输路线运作受影响。

imitation.background_zh: 假设生产计划：停电影响物料配送。
imitation.sentence_en: The outage disrupted deliveries to the assembly line.
imitation.translation_zh: 停电影响了装配线的物料配送。

context.en: disrupted an important supply route
context.zh: 使一条重要补给线的运输受阻

items.example: The Kremlin vowed to rebuild the damaged crossing after the strike.
items.cloze: The Kremlin ______ to rebuild the damaged crossing after the strike.
items.analysis_zh: vowed to rebuild 采用 vow + to do，表示强烈的公开未来承诺。新闻只能确认当局作出承诺，不能推断重建已完成；pledged 也适合正式承诺，vowed 的决心语气更强。
items.why_zh: vowed to rebuild 采用 vow + to do，表示强烈的公开未来承诺。

imitation.background_zh: 假设灾后修复：官员承诺重建道路。
imitation.sentence_en: Officials vowed to rebuild the road after flooding.
imitation.translation_zh: 官员承诺在洪水后重建道路。

context.en: vowed to rebuild the damaged crossing
context.zh: 誓言重建受损的桥梁

items.example: The NSA reported a temporary network degradation during planned maintenance.
items.cloze: The NSA reported a temporary network ______ during planned maintenance.
items.analysis_zh: network degradation 指网络服务质量或性能下降，temporary 限定其持续时间。它不必然意味着全面离线；outage 通常表示服务中断，degradation 更适合报道中的谨慎技术措辞。
items.why_zh: network degradation 指网络服务质量或性能下降，temporary 限定其持续时间。

imitation.background_zh: 假设系统运维：维护期间响应变慢。
imitation.sentence_en: Engineers observed network degradation during maintenance.
imitation.translation_zh: 工程师在维护期间观察到网络性能下降。

context.en: a temporary network degradation
context.zh: 网络性能暂时下降

items.example: Apple acknowledged that a software update had caused internal outages.
items.cloze: Apple ______ that a software update had caused internal outages.
items.analysis_zh: acknowledged that + 从句用于机构正式确认事实，had caused 以过去完成时说明更新在声明前引发问题。admitted 有时带被迫承认的色彩，acknowledged 更适合中性新闻归因。
items.why_zh: acknowledged that + 从句用于机构正式确认事实，had caused 以过去完成时说明更新在声明前引发问题。

imitation.background_zh: 假设软件项目：承认更新影响报表。
imitation.sentence_en: The developer acknowledged that the update had affected reports.
imitation.translation_zh: 开发人员承认更新影响了报表。

context.en: acknowledged that a software update had caused internal outages
context.zh: 承认一次软件更新导致内部服务中断

items.example: Both organisations denied that cyber-attacks had caused the problems.
items.cloze: Both organisations ______ that cyber-attacks had caused the problems.
items.analysis_zh: denied that + 完整从句明确表示两家机构否认网络攻击是原因。否认是当事机构的声明，不能等同独立调查的最终结论；deny 后接 that 从句，不能机械换成 deny to do。
items.why_zh: denied that + 完整从句明确表示两家机构否认网络攻击是原因。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合同沟通：否认系统导致延误。
imitation.sentence_en: The supplier denied that its system had caused the delay.
imitation.translation_zh: 供应商否认其系统造成了延误。

context.en: denied that cyber-attacks had caused the problems
context.zh: 否认这些问题由网络攻击引起

items.example: Lawmakers elected Matan Kahana as the new speaker of parliament.
items.cloze: Lawmakers ______ Matan Kahana as the new speaker of parliament.
items.analysis_zh: elected somebody as speaker 表示通过选举使某人担任议长，as 引出职位。elect 强调投票程序，appoint 更常指任命；这里报道的是议会选举结果。
items.why_zh: elected somebody as speaker 表示通过选举使某人担任议长，as 引出职位。

imitation.background_zh: 假设社团活动：成员投票选主席。
imitation.sentence_en: Members elected a chair at their annual meeting.
imitation.translation_zh: 成员在年度会议上选出一名主席。

context.en: elected Matan Kahana as the new speaker of parliament
context.zh: 选举马坦·卡哈纳为新任议长

items.example: The result strengthened the opposition's influence over the legislative agenda.
items.cloze: The result ______ the opposition's influence over the legislative agenda.
items.analysis_zh: strengthened influence over the legislative agenda 表示对立法议程的影响力增加，over 引出影响范围。influence 不等于 control，不能据此断言反对派已掌握政府全部权力。
items.why_zh: strengthened influence over the legislative agenda 表示对立法议程的影响力增加，over 引出影响范围。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目治理：新增席位提升团队话语权。
imitation.sentence_en: The new seat strengthened engineers' influence over design.
imitation.translation_zh: 新增席位增强了工程师对设计的影响力。

context.en: strengthened the opposition's influence over the legislative agenda
context.zh: 增强了反对派对立法议程的影响力

items.example: Gadi Eisenkot received the first chance to assemble a viable government.
items.cloze: Gadi Eisenkot received the first chance to ______ a viable government.
items.analysis_zh: assemble a viable government 指通过协调政党形成能够运作的政府，viable 强调可行性。received the first chance 仅说明优先组阁权，不能宣称已成功组阁；form 也符合此句。
items.why_zh: assemble a viable government 指通过协调政党形成能够运作的政府，viable 强调可行性。

imitation.background_zh: 假设跨部门项目：组建能执行任务的团队。
imitation.sentence_en: The manager was asked to assemble a viable project team.
imitation.translation_zh: 经理被要求组建一支能够运作的项目团队。

context.en: assemble a viable government
context.zh: 组建一个能够有效运作的政府

items.example: The three leaders held unprecedented trilateral talks in Shenzhen.
items.cloze: The three leaders held ______ trilateral talks in Shenzhen.
items.analysis_zh: unprecedented trilateral talks 由形容词修饰三边会谈，强调这种会谈此前没有先例。它描述会议形式，未对外交成果作出评价；historic 往往暗含重大历史意义，语气更强。
items.why_zh: 突出首次三边会谈这一事实。

imitation.background_zh: 假设三家合作商首次开会
imitation.sentence_en: The partners held an unprecedented joint meeting.
imitation.translation_zh: 合作伙伴举行了一场史无前例的联合会议。

context.en: held unprecedented trilateral talks
context.zh: 举行了史无前例的三方会谈

items.example: Xi characterised the discussion as groundbreaking, but no detailed agreement was disclosed.
items.cloze: Xi characterised the discussion as ______, but no detailed agreement was disclosed.
items.analysis_zh: characterised the discussion as groundbreaking 使用 characterise A as B 结构，groundbreaking 是讲话者对讨论的评价。but 后面说明协议细节尚未披露，不能将这一评价当作已证实的谈判成果。
items.why_zh: 保留评价归因及协议尚未披露的限制。

imitation.background_zh: 假设项目负责人评价新流程
imitation.sentence_en: The manager described the new process as groundbreaking.
imitation.translation_zh: 经理称新流程具有开创性。

context.en: characterised the discussion as groundbreaking
context.zh: 称这次讨论具有开创性

items.example: Trump subsequently said Washington and Beijing wanted the war in Ukraine to end.
items.cloze: Trump ______ said Washington and Beijing wanted the war in Ukraine to end.
items.analysis_zh: subsequently said 中副词修饰过去时动词 said，说明外交会晤后的发言顺序。subsequently 只表示时间先后；therefore 表示因果，两者不可混淆，避免暗示会谈直接促成这一表态。
items.why_zh: 准确表示会谈之后的时间顺序。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合同谈判
imitation.sentence_en: The teams negotiated prices and subsequently agreed on delivery terms.
imitation.translation_zh: 双方谈妥价格，随后就交货条款达成一致。

context.en: Trump subsequently said Washington and Beijing wanted the war in Ukraine to end
context.zh: 特朗普随后表示，美中两国政府都希望乌克兰战争结束

items.example: Anthropic's public offering eclipsed previous listing records by raising $81bn.
items.cloze: Anthropic's public offering ______ previous listing records by raising $81bn.
items.analysis_zh: eclipsed previous listing records 使用 eclipse + 宾语表示新纪录盖过旧纪录，过去时说明融资已经完成。surpassed 和 exceeded 也表示超过；eclipsed 更强调旧纪录因此显得逊色。
items.why_zh: 突出了融资规模刷新上市纪录。

imitation.background_zh: 假设新品销量破纪录
imitation.sentence_en: The new product eclipsed the previous sales record.
imitation.translation_zh: 新产品打破并超越了此前的销售纪录。

context.en: eclipsed previous listing records
context.zh: 打破了以往的上市纪录

items.example: The offer price implied a valuation of roughly $1.5trn.
items.cloze: The offer price ______ a valuation of roughly $1.5trn.
items.analysis_zh: implied a valuation of roughly $1.5trn 表示发行价对应的推算估值；roughly 保留估算性质。implied valuation 是金融分析术语，不能将估值与企业实际收到的融资金额混为一谈。
items.why_zh: 准确区分发行价格对应的估值和融资额。

imitation.background_zh: 假设企业收购报价
imitation.sentence_en: The revised bid implied a higher company valuation.
imitation.translation_zh: 修订后的报价意味着更高的企业估值。

context.en: implied a valuation of roughly $1.5trn
context.zh: 对应的估值约为1.5万亿美元

items.example: The successful flotation offered some relief after a sell-off in technology shares.
items.cloze: The successful flotation offered some ______ after a sell-off in technology shares.
items.analysis_zh: offered some relief 中 relief 为不可数名词，some 限定改善程度。sell-off 指集中抛售；relief 只表示压力有所缓解，不能等同于 recovery 所暗示的市场全面恢复。
items.why_zh: 审慎描述科技股下跌后的短暂情绪改善。

imitation.background_zh: 假设物料短缺
imitation.sentence_en: The delivery brought some relief to the production team.
imitation.translation_zh: 这次交货让生产团队稍感宽慰。

context.en: offered some relief after a sell-off in technology shares
context.zh: 在科技股遭到抛售之后，让市场稍稍松了一口气

items.example: Washington and Caracas agreed to restore military ties.
items.cloze: Washington and Caracas agreed to ______ military ties.
items.analysis_zh: restore military ties 是 restore + 名词宾语，强调双方恢复原先存在的军事联系。与 establish military ties 表示首次建立关系不同，restore 包含关系曾经中断或削弱的背景。
items.why_zh: 明确双方恢复已有联系的事实。

imitation.background_zh: 假设合作商恢复例会
imitation.sentence_en: The partners agreed to restore their monthly meetings.
imitation.translation_zh: 合作伙伴同意恢复每月例会。

context.en: restore military ties
context.zh: 恢复军事关系

items.example: The agreement envisages joint exercises and intelligence sharing.
items.cloze: The agreement ______ joint exercises and intelligence sharing.
items.analysis_zh: agreement envisages joint exercises 是 envisage + 名词短语，说明协议拟安排的合作内容。envisage 不保证相关活动已经开展；completed 或 conducted 才可描述已经执行的行动。
items.why_zh: 准确区分协议计划与已经执行的活动。

imitation.background_zh: 假设扩产计划
imitation.sentence_en: The expansion plan envisages a second production line.
imitation.translation_zh: 扩产方案设想增加第二条生产线。

context.en: envisages joint exercises and intelligence sharing
context.zh: 设想开展联合演习并共享情报

items.example: The defence chief's visit occurred amid a wider political realignment.
items.cloze: The defence chief's visit occurred amid a wider political ______.
items.analysis_zh: political realignment 是名词短语，指政治力量及关系格局的调整；amid 引出访问发生时的背景。realignment 与 reconciliation 有区别，后者强调和解，报道未能证明各方已经全面和解。
items.why_zh: 概括政治关系变化并避免推断全面和解。

imitation.background_zh: 假设组织重组
imitation.sentence_en: The restructuring prompted a realignment of responsibilities.
imitation.translation_zh: 重组促使职责重新调整。

context.en: a wider political realignment
context.zh: 范围更广的政治格局调整

items.example: The agency said reducing reliance on the Strait of Hormuz would require major spending.
items.cloze: The agency said reducing ______ on the Strait of Hormuz would require major spending.
items.analysis_zh: reducing reliance on 使用 reliance on 的固定介词搭配，指对霍尔木兹海峡运输通道的依赖。would require 是条件性预测，说明降低依赖需要投入，不能写成投资已实际完成。
items.why_zh: 强调降低对运输通道依赖的条件。

imitation.background_zh: 假设采购多元化
imitation.sentence_en: The factory aims to reduce reliance on one supplier.
imitation.translation_zh: 工厂希望减少对单一供应商的依赖。

context.en: reducing reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
context.zh: 降低对霍尔木兹海峡的依赖

items.example: Its outlook estimated $40bn for pipelines and $200bn for oil fields.
items.cloze: Its ______ estimated $40bn for pipelines and $200bn for oil fields.
items.analysis_zh: Its outlook 指国际能源署的能源展望报告，名词作主语。outlook 在此是预测性出版物，不能理解为市场乐观情绪；estimated 后的金额属于机构估算，并非已发生的投资。
items.why_zh: 准确标注金额来自机构展望报告的估算。

imitation.background_zh: 假设市场研究
imitation.sentence_en: The annual outlook predicts slower demand growth.
imitation.translation_zh: 年度展望报告预测需求增长放缓。

context.en: Its outlook estimated $40bn for pipelines and $200bn for oil fields
context.zh: 该机构在展望报告中估算，管道需要投入400亿美元，油田需要投入2000亿美元

items.example: Conflict in Iran could accelerate efforts to develop domestic energy.
items.cloze: Conflict in Iran could ______ efforts to develop domestic energy.
items.analysis_zh: could accelerate efforts to develop 使用 could + 动词原形表达可能性；accelerate efforts to do sth 表示加快推进某项工作。与 trigger 表示触发行动不同，accelerate 强调速度提高。
items.why_zh: 保留可能性并准确描述政策反应。

imitation.background_zh: 假设本地采购
imitation.sentence_en: A shortage could accelerate efforts to source materials locally.
imitation.translation_zh: 短缺可能加快本地采购材料的工作。

context.en: accelerate efforts to develop domestic energy
context.zh: 加快开发本国能源的步伐

items.example: Israeli tanks crossed the ceasefire boundary known as the yellow line.
items.cloze: Israeli tanks crossed the ceasefire ______ known as the yellow line.
items.analysis_zh: crossed the ceasefire boundary 中 cross 直接接宾语，无需再加 over。boundary 指停火安排划定的分界线；border 通常用于国家边境，因此 boundary 更贴合此处协议控制线。
items.why_zh: 描述坦克越过停火分界线的行动。

imitation.background_zh: 假设厂区安全
imitation.sentence_en: Vehicles must not cross the marked safety boundary.
imitation.translation_zh: 车辆不得越过标记的安全界线。

context.en: crossed the ceasefire boundary
context.zh: 越过停火分界线

items.example: The military described its incursion as limited and aimed at removing threats.
items.cloze: The military described its ______ as limited and aimed at removing threats.
items.analysis_zh: described its incursion as limited 使用 describe A as B，明确 limited 是以军对行动规模的自我描述。incursion 指进入他方控制区域的行动，通常比 invasion 范围小；规模仍需独立核实。
items.why_zh: 保留行动性质及其有限规模的消息归因。

imitation.background_zh: 假设网络安全演练
imitation.sentence_en: The exercise simulated an incursion into a secure network.
imitation.translation_zh: 演练模拟了对安全网络的侵入。

context.en: described its incursion as limited
context.zh: 称此次越界军事行动规模有限

items.example: Israel separately reported air strikes that it said killed two commanders.
items.cloze: Israel separately ______ air strikes that it said killed two commanders.
items.analysis_zh: Israel reported air strikes that it said killed 使用 reported 和 it said 双重归因，限定袭击和伤亡信息来自以方。涉及冲突中的死亡数字，不能省略来源限定改写为独立核实的事实。
items.why_zh: 冲突伤亡信息需要明确来源。

imitation.background_zh: 假设质量整改
imitation.sentence_en: The supplier reported that it had completed corrective actions.
imitation.translation_zh: 供应商报告称已完成纠正措施。

context.en: reported air strikes

items.example: Grand Theft Auto VI made its long-awaited debut to enthusiastic reviews.

items.example: Despite the broader sell-off, Anthropic's first-day closing price valued the company at nearly $1.3trn.

items.example: European leaders signalled a willingness to discuss a possible end to the war in Ukraine after an invitation from Vladimir Putin.

items.cloze: European leaders ______ a willingness to discuss a possible end to the war in Ukraine after an invitation from Vladimir Putin.

items.example: Putin had invited the leaders to Moscow to clarify their positions on a settlement.

items.example: A short-seller separately alleged that restricted Chinese organisations could still obtain AMD technology.

items.why_zh: Senate rejected a proposal 在本句中表示“参议院否决了一项提案”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

items.cloze: President Nayib Bukele announced his ______ for a third term in El Salvador.
items.why_zh: announced his candidacy for a third term 在本句中表示“宣布竞选第三个任期”，此处的词形及搭配与报道事实吻合。

items.cloze: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed ______ against the Rohingya minority in 2017.
